fields.name: key
fields.label: Brand Key

fields.name: name

fields.name: tagline

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo Image
fields.description: Brand logo. PNG/SVG with transparent background works best.

fields.name: url

fields.description: Optional link out to the brand’s site.

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Short Label
fields.description: Caption shown on hover (e.g. "Spray-On Bedliner — Ram 1500").

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Filter group (e.g. "bedliner", "ceramic", "hitch", "window-tint"). Used by the gallery filter pills.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Photo
fields.description: The gallery photo. Landscape works best.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Optional tags for searching/grouping.

fields.name: size
fields.label: Tile Size
fields.description: Visual height in the grid.

fields.name: sortOrder
fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first.

fields.name: active

fields.description: Uncheck to temporarily hide.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Service Name
fields.description: How the service appears in menus and listings (e.g. "Spray-In Bedliner").

fields.name: slug
fields.label: URL Slug
fields.description: Used in the URL: /services/<slug>.html. Lowercase, dashes only.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: Group used for filtering — e.g. "bedliners", "protection", "truck-accessories".

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Short Summary

fields.label: Copy Variety Check
fields.description: Automatically warns if Summary, Hero Badge, and Hero Subheadline say the same thing — and rewrites them with AI.

fields.name: icon

fields.name: hero
fields.label: Hero Section (Top of Page)

fields.label: Hero Badge

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Hero Background Image

fields.name: textAlign

fields.name: subheadline

fields.name: primaryCtaLabel

fields.name: secondaryCtaLabel

fields.name: secondaryCtaUrl

fields.description: For phone, use tel:3013041419. For another page, use a path like /contact.html.

fields.name: pricing
